Tea Seller's Bank Account Frozen After Small UPI Transaction

A tea seller reportedly had his bank account frozen after a small UPI transaction of Rs 20. The incident led to a significant amount of money in his account being frozen. Details of the full case and the reasons behind the freezing of funds are being investigated.
